profile.reading:
This is Digital Realty facility EWR21, at 2 Peekay Drive, Clifton, NJ 07014. Digital Realty's own property listing confirms this address as EWR21, but this session's fetch did not return a confirmed square footage figure for it specifically.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's New York/New Jersey metro footprint, which spans historic Manhattan carrier hotels and a cluster of suburban New Jersey buildings in Clifton and Piscataway Township, coded EWR10 through EWR21 on the company's own metro listing. Digital Realty markets these properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand, positioning the metro alongside Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, and Silicon Valley, all tracked elsewhere in this registry, as core hubs in its global interconnection and colocation platform. PSE&G serves most of the northern New Jersey data center market.

Digital Realty's FY2025 Form 10-K identifies the United States as its largest single national market by both facility count and rentable square footage, discloses portfolio metrics by region and metro rather than by individual building, and this pattern is consistent across every Digital Realty property researched by this registry this session, not specific to this entry.

reading.body:
Digital Realty's EWR21 in Clifton is a 215,000 square foot colocation facility at 2 Peekay Drive, part of the operator's New York/New Jersey hub. The facility holds certifications for security (SOC 2, SOC 3, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), quality (ISO 9001), environmental management (ISO 14001), and sustainability (Energy Star, LEED Platinum). Digital Realty does not publish an IT megawatt capacity figure for this building on its property page or in its public filings; the company discloses portfolio metrics only at regional and metropolitan level.

This building is one of approximately 48 data center facilities mapped in New Jersey, of which only 5 operators publish power capacity figures. It ranks sixth among the state's facilities with disclosed megawatt figures. The surrounding Clifton and Piscataway Township cluster shares a onsite substation providing 2N utility redundancy, though per-building power allocation is not published. PSE&G serves the northern New Jersey grid where this facility operates.

Without published IT load, the facility's relevance to AI scaling cannot be read from the specifications alone. The colocation model indicates the site hosts customer compute rather than operator-owned infrastructure. The certifications and suburban location near Manhattan position it within Digital Realty's interconnection platform serving financial services and hyperscaler tenants, but which customers operate here and at what densities remain unpublished.
